data.notice:
This is a first-round interview for Customer Support Team Lead with Example Ltd. The interviewer is an AI, not a person.

Where it runs: the interview runs in the Snazzy Pro app with an AI model on your own computer. Nothing is sent while you take it. When it ends, the app sends the transcript of the interview (the questions and your answers, as text) to Example Ltd.

What happens: the AI asks every candidate for this role the same main questions in the same order, and may ask short follow-up questions about your answers. It takes about 25 minutes. You can ask for any question to be repeated or rephrased, and you can pause. At the end you can ask your own questions.

Who decides: a person at Example Ltd reads your answers and makes the decision. The AI does not decide, rank or reject anyone. After the interview, the transcript is summarised by an AI model run by the hiring team's service provider against the skills the role needs, and a person on the hiring team reviews your answers alongside that summary.

What is not used: the AI does not analyse your face, voice, tone, emotions or typing. Only the words of your answers are assessed. Personal details you mention (for example about health, family or religion) are hidden from the assessment.

Your data: the transcript is kept by Example Ltd for up to 180 days after a decision, then deleted. You can ask Example Ltd for a copy, a correction or deletion at any time.

Adjustments: tell us below if you need extra time, a pause, text instead of voice or anything else. Asking won't count against you.

If you'd rather speak to a person instead, choose "I'd prefer to speak to a person". That won't count against you either.
